shutdown.title: Shut down {{target}}?
shutdown.description: Unraid stops containers, VMs and the array and switches the server off. Use “Wake” to switch it on again.

shutdownWithVm.title: Shut down the VM first?
shutdownWithVm.description: {{vm}} is running. TwinRaid shuts down the VM first and then {{target}}. If the VM does not react, TwinRaid stops and the server keeps running.

vmStop.title: Shut down {{vm}}?
vmStop.description_one: The VM receives the shutdown signal, like a short press of the power button. If it does not react within {{count}} minute, “Force off” becomes possible.
vmStop.description_other: The VM receives the shutdown signal, like a short press of the power button. If it does not react within {{count}} minutes, “Force off” becomes possible.

force.title: Switch {{vm}} off immediately?
force.description: The VM is switched off at once, like pulling the power plug. Unsaved data in the VM is lost.

forceAndShutdown.title: Force {{vm}} off and then shut down {{target}}?
forceAndShutdown.description: Warning: forcing is like pulling the power plug of the VM. It is switched off at once without shutting down. Unsaved data in the VM is lost, running Windows updates are interrupted. Then TwinRaid shuts down {{target}} cleanly. If the VM still stays on, the server keeps running.
forceAndShutdown.confirm: Force VM off and shut down server

hints.forceAndShutdownUntil: “Force off, then shut down server” is possible until {{time}}.
hints.checkWake: Check Wake-on-LAN in the BIOS and with ethtool, as well as the array auto start.
hints.checkShutdown: Please look at the web interface of the server.
